name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold company operating a hybrid royalty and exploration model across properties in Nevada and Idaho. Its primary focus is the Lapon Canyon Gold Project within the Walker Lane gold trend of Nevada, where the company holds a 3% Net Smelter Royalty and an Exploration Stream Earn-in Agreement with Walker River Resources, funding up to $5M in drilling. The company is in the exploration stage and expects to complete an initial NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate in 2026.
